svg.title: Dream House coordinated upper-floor plan
svg.desc: An upper-floor revision unifying the primary bathroom as one L-shaped room without an intermediate wall or door. Not for construction.
svg.metadata: {"construction_authority":false,"drawing":"DH-ARQ-PLN-002-R19","model_sha256":"fa76a1470977d717bac95f81d0c551547e659c30adebfb9b2ec4b2ba11e778ac","revision":"0.3-draft-22-P2","status":"issued for coordination under D-066; primary-bathroom waterproofing, drainage, ventilation, privacy and detailed MEP remain open; not for construction"}
svg.text: D-066 unified primary bathroom + D-065 suite rebalance
P2 PLAN · 18.00 x 15.00 m · +3.80 m STUDY LEVEL

text.tspan: Unify the 17.60 m2 primary bathroom as one open L-shaped room.
Move laundry into PB storage behind the Great Wall.
Keep the large exposed X=21 truss on the hall side of P2-W04.
P2-W04R closes bedroom ends; the shared family frontage stays open.
P2-W05 gives all exterior P2 rooms a refined double-frame envelope.

svg.text: Unified bathroom 17.60 m2 gross / 15.66 m2 schematic net; no intermediate door.
The residual 6.53 m2 spur becomes the dry wellness threshold.
Mini deck + family centre share one 7.45 m open guarded hall edge.
Mini-deck sightline governs the single large X=21 truss.
Four D-048 column reservations remain at stair corners.
W01/W04R: 250 mm at enclosed zones; family balcony edge open.
A rear retractable stair is reserved, but its acceptance as a second exit awaits D-021 and professional fire review
The large exposed X=21 truss must preserve the family-balcony opening; guard, members, joints and fire protection remain undesigned
Solar control, privacy and final glazing await the selected site and orientation
The stair-to-family-room arrival is an architectural objective only; fire separation, smoke control and door strategy await professional design
The reserved exterior route crosses the dry wellness threshold; professional fire review must accept it or require a separated clear lane
The open family balcony intentionally gives up D-058 acoustic continuity; guarding, smoke transfer and hall-to-suite noise require professional design
P2-W05 hygrothermal, wind, fire and window interfaces await professional design
W04R closes bedrooms; family edge is open and guarded.
D-066 · UNIFIED PRIMARY BATHROOM · DESIGN COORDINATION
Current architectural coordination hypothesis. It does not authorize procurement, fabrication or construction.
